additional_evidence_design.neutrality_rule: A future evidence-acquisition step must not preselect positive or negative admissibility outcomes.
additional_evidence_design.permitted_future_goal: Acquire or bind only evidence needed to determine whether each authoritative carrier candidate has sufficient governed support for a later B2 disposition decision.
additional_evidence_design.source_scope_rule: Any additional source or evidence class must be explicitly enumerated and checksum-bound by a later authorization. No open-ended repository or external-source search is authorized by D0241.

future_reuse_preconditions: Each reused artifact must be separately enumerated by exact repository path.
Each reused artifact must be bound by exact SHA-256 and, where applicable, Git blob identity and governing decision provenance.
Reuse must preserve the original bounded semantic meaning of the artifact.
SUPPORTED_BINDING may be treated only as its governed binding result and not automatically as an INCLUDED carrier disposition.
UNRESOLVED_BINDING may not be treated as EXCLUDED or as negative proof.
No historical evidence may be semantically promoted beyond its governed scope.

future_authorization_ladder.name: EXACT_EXISTING_EVIDENCE_INVENTORY_AND_BINDING
future_authorization_ladder.purpose: Enumerate and checksum-bind the exact existing governed evidence eligible for reuse.

future_authorization_ladder.name: BOUNDED_ADDITIONAL_EVIDENCE_ACQUISITION
future_authorization_ladder.purpose: Acquire only explicitly authorized additional evidence required by unresolved candidate-admissibility questions.

future_authorization_ladder.name: NEUTRAL_CARRIER_ADMISSIBILITY_EVIDENCE_ADJUDICATION
future_authorization_ladder.purpose: Evaluate the bound evidence without preselecting positive or negative outcomes and without constructing AEA02.

future_authorization_ladder.name: ZERO_UNRESOLVED_CLOSURE_VERIFICATION_AND_GOVERNANCE
future_authorization_ladder.purpose: Verify exact candidate coverage, zero unresolved evidence states, and closure provenance before any B2 readiness decision.

future_authorization_ladder.name: POST_CLOSURE_B2_READINESS_REASSESSMENT
future_authorization_ladder.purpose: Perform a separate read-only B2 readiness assessment after verified closure.

future_authorization_ladder.name: SEPARATE_B2_AUTHORIZATION
future_authorization_ladder.purpose: Authorize B2 only through a later explicit governance checkpoint if all prerequisites are established.

closure_acceptance_criteria: Exactly 171 authoritative candidate identifiers are accounted for.
Every authoritative candidate appears exactly once.
No candidate is omitted, duplicated, manually added, or silently filtered.
Every candidate has evidence sufficient for exactly one later INCLUDED-or-EXCLUDED B2 disposition path.
No negative conclusion is derived solely from absence of positive evidence.
All evidence and adjudication inputs are checksum-bound and provenance-bound.
Closure verification is machine recomputed and not satisfied by self-declared booleans.

purpose.primary: Define the bounded governance design for closing the carrier-admissibility evidence gap before any B2 readiness decision or B2 authorization.
purpose.reason: The authoritative candidate universe and source bindings are governed, but zero-unresolved carrier-admissibility closure is not established.
